qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology / Management / Economics / Commerce / Science
qualification.details: Senior Manager – Category Management (Products): Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Technology / Management / Economics / Commerce / Science from a recognized institution. Minimum 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3-year of Category Management experience in E-commerce or at least 3-year experience in supply chain management. Senior Manager – Product approval: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Technology / Management / Commerce / Science from a recognized institution. Minimum 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3-year of experience in Catalogue Management, Quality Assurance and Certification, Public Procurement, Supply Chain Management or E-commerce Operations. Senior Manager – Vendor Validation: Bachelor’s degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Management / Economics / Commerce/ Law from a recognized institution. Minimum 8 years of total professional experience, including at least 3-year of experience in Vendor capability /compliance assessment, Quality Assurance and Certification, or Public Procurement.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for GeM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GeM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Government eMarketplace (GeM) for hiring contractual professionals in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under GeM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Senior Manager posts across various specialized categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The openings include Senior Manager – Category Management (Products), Senior Manager – Product approval, and Senior Manager – Vendor Validation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for GeM Senior Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through email to the designated official email address provided by GeM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Management, Economics, Commerce, Science, or Law depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for applying to these contractual posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are offered on a contractual basis for an initial period of 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for GeM Manager posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of GeM?
faq.answer: The official website of Government eMarketplace can be accessed at https://gem.gov.in/.
